sessions.phase_label: Creative brief and reset to V-system foundations
Hero V convergence and signature V-family development
Full wordmark construction, hierarchy, and composition
Material, kerning, terminal, and signature alignment studies

requirements.title: Hero V Master Geometry
requirements.definition: The opening Hero V must provide the approved master geometry and distinctive architectural character from which the VELLVÉ identity is constructed.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the Hero V itself, including its silhouette, arm relationship, endpoint elevation, and terminal treatment. The second V and É accent remain separate because their derivation and hierarchy repeatedly failed or changed independently.

requirements.title: Second V Design and Hierarchy
requirements.definition: The second V must belong to the Hero V's proprietary language while functioning as a quieter supporting echo with the required relationship to the surrounding letters.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers whether the second V is scaled or optically drawn, its restrained supporting character, and its height relationship to the alphabet. It is separate from the Hero V because its construction method and hierarchy were repeatedly modified independently.

requirements.title: É Accent Derivation and Alignment
requirements.definition: The É accent must use the required literal geometry from the Hero V's right-arm termination and maintain the specified peak alignment with the Hero V.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the accent's literal vector derivation, terminal identity, and peak alignment. It remains separate because the accent could be incorrect even when the approved Hero V was preserved.

requirements.title: Architectural E and L Letterforms
requirements.definition: The E and L characters must be custom architectural forms that belong naturally to the same proprietary alphabet as the signature V system.
requirements.boundary_note: The E and L are retained as one tightly coupled letterform mechanism because the history consistently assigns them the same architectural vocabulary and explores them together. Case, spacing, and baseline behavior are independently changeable and remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Wordmark Case Treatment
requirements.definition: The complete VELLVÉ wordmark must use the client-selected case treatment, initially prioritizing an all-caps architectural construction.
requirements.boundary_note: Case treatment can be reconsidered without changing the underlying V geometry, letter spacing, or material finish, so it is independent rather than an attribute of a broad composition Requirement.

requirements.title: Wordmark Kerning and Rhythm
requirements.definition: The wordmark's optical spacing must make VELLVÉ read as one cohesive mark while retaining an elegant and appropriately open cadence.
requirements.boundary_note: Kerning is independently adjustable and has its own acceptance criterion: eliminating the perceived 'VE | LL | VÉ' grouping without making the mark compressed. It is separate from baseline and case treatment.

requirements.title: Wordmark Baseline Alignment
requirements.definition: The V and alphabet letterforms must use the selected common-baseline relationship in the complete wordmark.
requirements.boundary_note: Baseline placement can be tested and selected independently of kerning, letterform geometry, and signature-element peak hierarchy.

requirements.title: Champagne Gold Finish
requirements.definition: The wordmark must support a warm, restrained champagne-gold material finish that feels sophisticated and luxurious without becoming flashy.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the material character, such as matte, brushed, or satin reflection. Which specific wordmark elements receive gold is independently selectable and belongs to the separate distribution Requirement.

requirements.title: Champagne Gold Distribution
requirements.definition: Champagne gold must be distributed across the selected signature elements while the remaining wordmark elements use the selected contrasting treatment.
requirements.boundary_note: Color placement can change while the Satin Reflection finish remains unchanged, so distribution and finish are separate Requirements rather than attributes of one broad material Requirement.

requirements.title: Preservation of Locked Design Assets
requirements.definition: Every subsequent revision must carry forward approved geometry and architectural relationships unchanged unless the client explicitly requests a change.
requirements.boundary_note: This is an artifact-integrity constraint rather than generic project management: each submitted proof must preserve fixed vector assets and relationships. It has a distinct repeated failure trajectory separate from whether any one letterform is aesthetically successful.

requirements.title: Design Review Presentation Protocol
requirements.definition: Design rounds must be presented with enough structured comparison, rationale, and verification guidance for the client to evaluate the intended variable and confirm locked relationships.
requirements.boundary_note: Concept explanations, complete-system comparisons, isolated-variable studies, guides, and paired guided/unguided views are attributes of one review-presentation mechanism. This does not represent generic QA or debugging.

requirements.title: Accessible Review Image Formats
requirements.definition: Review images must be supplied in a format the client can open, such as a directly embedded image, JPG, or PNG rather than inaccessible JFIF files.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a concrete delivery-interface behavior with its own repeated failures, not a generic request to test the design or an attribute of the wordmark itself.

requirements.title: Editable Asset and Export Handoff
requirements.definition: The project must provide the required editable source/vector files, presentation boards, and exported artwork in the applicable final or current-state package.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the deliverable package, including editable vector/source formats and required export variants. The later current-state working-file handoff can replace the earlier expectation of a polished production package without creating a separate administrative Requirement.
